# Fixture forum-03: synthetic forum site,
# modeled on real-world robots.txt patterns (hand-written pools).

User-agent: cl0q-crawler
Disallow: /wp-admin/
Disallow: /private/
Disallow: /backup/
Disallow: /download/private/
Disallow: /register
Disallow: /*?
Disallow: /*/print/

Allow: /about
Allow: /api/public/

User-agent: *
Disallow: /wp-admin/
